dialogue.user: Thanks for the options! Those all have great ratings. I'm interested in something practical and good value for everyday wear. The Nike Zoom Pegasus Turbo 2 at $105 sounds really interesting — that seems like a great price. Can you tell me a bit more about those? Are they comfortable and well-made? Also, are any of these shoes made with quality materials that would last?
dialogue.agent:
Great choices! Here's what I found:

**Nike Men's Zoom Pegasus Turbo 2 Black/Pink Blast Sneakers 14** ($105.00):
- Rubber sole
- Rated 5.0/5 — a buyer says it's their "go-to" running shoe and they're on their 4th pair
- One review mentions these lasted over **800 miles** of running, calling them "wildly exceed expectations" and "remarkable" — that's fantastic durability for a $105 shoe
- Lightweight and great for everyday running/walking

**ECCO Soft 7 Cloud Sneaker** ($169.95, up to $200):
- Premium materials: **leather upper**, leather and textile lining, **removable leather insole**, PU/TPU sole
- ECCO is known for quality craftsmanship and durable construction
- A step up in materials for longevity

Between the two, the **Nike Pegasus Turbo 2** offers amazing value at $105 with proven durability from real buyers. The **ECCO Soft 7** uses higher-end materials with leather construction and a comfortable PU/TPU sole, but at a higher $169.95 price point.

Would you like more details on either of these, or are there any particular features or styles you're looking for?

top_reviews.title: 💥🔥💪🏻
top_reviews.text: Overall great running shoe. My go to!  This new pair makes my 4th

top_reviews.title: Wildly exceed expectations
top_reviews.text: I've been running in Nike shoes for more than 30 years. I normally get about 400-450 miles per pair of Nike running shoes (my last favorite running shoe was the Nike Air Max). These Zoom Pegasus Turbo 2 shoes are remarkable; the last pair survived for more than EIGHT HUNDRED MILES! (I average about 60 miles of running on roads per month.) And they are so lightweight, they're a joy to run in. I couldn't believe the mileage -- 800+ miles! I have purchased two more pairs because I'm worried Nike will stop making this wonderful shoe.
